title: Amblyopy
summary: AM'BLYOPY, noun [Gr. dull, and eye.] Incipient amaurosis; dulness or obscurity of sight, without any apparent defect of the organs; sight so depraved that objects can be seen only in a certain light,

inlines.v: AM'BLYOPY, noun [Gr. dull, and eye.] Incipient amaurosis; dulness or obscurity of sight, without any apparent defect of the organs; sight so depraved that objects can be seen only in a certain light, distance, or position.
